findings.title: Stepper step-level block for guarantor is E2E-only — no automated test wires required-cohort render through the stepper
findings.evidence: scenario step 4d: 'STEP-LEVEL BLOCK: click [data-testid="step-continue-guarantor"] with the fields empty — the stepper must NOT advance'; form_stepper.test.js has generic findInvalidControls tests (visible/required/hidden-wrapper rules) but zero guarantor-specific cases (grep 'guarantor' → no match).
findings.detail: Spec AC #1 requires the stepper to block empty guarantor fields AT THE STEP. SSR preconditions (fields expanded + required) are unit-pinned in guarantor_section_test and generic gating in form_stepper.test.js, but the composition (required cohort → step blocked) is asserted only by the manual bug-hunt scenario, which is not CI.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a form_stepper.test.js case feeding a required-cohort fixture (synthetic _guarantor_fields_open=on + empty guarantor inputs) asserting findInvalidControls returns the guarantor fields so Continue is held.
